skill.name: video-to-music
skill.description: Create original music that follows a video's pacing, motion, and emotion. Sonilo can return audio, stems, preserved speech, or a scored video.
skill.summary: Compose a licensed, original soundtrack that matches the timing and mood of a finished video.
skill.author: sonilo-ai

security_audit.summary: One low-severity finding is confirmed: the raw REST example uploads a video and bearer token to Sonilo's API. The other 84 alerts are false positives from Markdown formatting, relative links, documented credential use, and media checks. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: The raw REST example transmits the selected video and bearer token to Sonilo.
remediation.suggestion: State that REST use uploads the video to api.sonilo.com, and request confirmation before sending sensitive footage.

content.user_title: Create Original Music for Your Video
content.value_statement: Finished videos often need music that follows their timing and emotional changes. This skill uses Sonilo to compose and deliver a synchronized original score.
actual_capabilities: Composes original music that follows a video's pacing, motion, emotion, and exact duration.
Returns an audio score in M4A or WAV format, or a new MP4 with music included.
Preserves speech, keeps original sound, and ducks music beneath dialogue when requested.
Generates up to ten creative variants after the user confirms the additional cost.
Separates generated music into drums, bass, vocals, and other instrument stems.
Accepts a local video path or an HTTPS video URL through supported Sonilo transports.
limitations: Requires a Sonilo account, authentication, network access, and upload of the selected video to Sonilo.
Generation may incur charges, and multiple variants increase cost in direct proportion to their count.
Videos must be 360 seconds or shorter and remain within the account upload limit.
Prompts cannot request specific artists, bands, or copyrighted lyrics.

use_cases.title: Score a finished edit
use_cases.description: Create music that follows scene changes, motion, and emotional beats in a trailer or short film.

use_cases.title: Protect spoken content
use_cases.description: Add background music to narrated clips while preserving speech and lowering music beneath the voice.

use_cases.title: Deliver campaign variations
use_cases.description: Generate several licensed music directions for a commercial video after confirming the added cost.

prompt_templates.title: Automatic video score
prompt_templates.prompt: Score [video path] with original music that follows the edit. Return audio only and let the footage determine the style.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the video is finished but no music direction is available.

prompt_templates.title: Directed soundtrack
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [genre] score for [video path]. Build toward [key moment], then finish with [ending mood]. Avoid [unwanted sounds].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the user has a clear style and emotional arc.

prompt_templates.title: Dialogue-safe scored video
prompt_templates.prompt: Score [video path] in a [style] direction. Return a new MP4, keep the original sound, and duck music beneath dialogue.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for interviews, narration, or talking-head videos.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced stems and variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [variant count] distinct scores for [video path] with prompt influence [value]. Include stems and use [M4A or WAV]. Confirm cost first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when an audio team needs options and separated instruments for mixing.

output_examples.input: Score trailer.mp4 with tense cinematic music that resolves warmly at the final logo.
output_examples.output: A duration-matched M4A score with tension through the main edit and a warm resolution at the logo.

output_examples.input: Add subtle electronic music to interview.mp4 and keep the speaker clear.
output_examples.output: A scored MP4 that retains the interview audio and lowers the music beneath speech.

output_examples.input: Create three upbeat directions for launch.mov and include instrument stems.
output: Three distinct synchronized score files after cost confirmation.
Separate drums, bass, vocals, and other stems for each successful score.

best_practices: Check video duration, existing audio, account limits, and expected cost before generation.
Use a short brief with genre, emotional arc, key synchronization moment, and excluded sounds.
Generate once, review the result, and refine the prompt before purchasing another variant.
anti_patterns: Do not generate paid variants without confirming their number and cost with the user.
Do not drop original dialogue or effects when the user expects them in the scored video.
Do not reference specific artists, bands, copyrighted lyrics, or unsupported videos longer than 360 seconds.

faq.question: Does the skill return audio or video?
faq.answer: It can return an M4A or WAV score. It can also return an MP4 with the score included.

faq.question: Can it keep dialogue and original sound?
faq.answer: Yes. Preserve speech for dialogue, or keep original sound to retain the complete source audio track.

faq.question: Does the music match the video length?
faq.answer: Yes. Sonilo automatically matches the generated score to the source video's duration.

faq.question: Can it create separate instrument stems?
faq.answer: Yes. It can return drums, bass, vocals, and other stems from the generated music.

faq.question: Are generations free?
faq.answer: Not always. API calls may incur charges, and requests with multiple variants increase the total cost.

faq.question: What video limits apply?
faq.answer: The video must be 360 seconds or shorter. The account upload-size limit also applies.
